properties.name: Object-Oriented Programming
properties.definition: Paradigm based on concept of objects that contain data and code

properties.name: Class Definition
properties.definition: Blueprint or template for creating objects, defining structure and behavior

properties.name: Inheritance
properties.definition: Mechanism allowing classes to inherit properties and methods from parent classes

properties.name: Polymorphism
properties.definition: Ability of objects to take multiple forms or methods to behave differently based on context

properties.name: Encapsulation
properties.definition: Bundling of data and methods together while hiding implementation details

properties.name: Abstraction
properties.definition: Process of hiding complexity by showing only necessary features

properties.name: Composition over Inheritance
properties.definition: Principle of using object composition instead of inheritance for greater flexibility

properties.name: Interface
properties.definition: Contract defining methods that implementing classes must provide

properties.name: SOLID Principles
properties.definition: Five design principles for maintainable and testable object-oriented software

nodes.label: ADR-001: Abstraction as Primary Design Tool

properties.title: Abstraction as Primary Design Tool
properties.context: Balance hiding complexity with exposing necessary interfaces
properties.decision: Use abstraction as primary architectural tool for hiding complexity and defining boundaries
properties.rationale: Enables testability, maintainability, flexibility, and team collaboration

nodes.label: ADR-002: Inheritance for IS-A, Composition for HAS-A

properties.title: Inheritance for IS-A, Composition for HAS-A
properties.context: Need clear guidance on when to use inheritance vs composition
properties.decision: Use inheritance for true IS-A relationships, composition for HAS-A relationships
properties.rationale: Prevents fragile hierarchies and improves code flexibility

properties.title: Single Responsibility Principle
properties.context: Classes tend to grow and become difficult to maintain
properties.decision: Each class should have a single reason to change

properties.title: Dependency Inversion Principle
properties.context: High-level modules depend on low-level modules causing tight coupling
properties.decision: Both should depend on abstractions, not concrete implementations
properties.rationale: Reduces coupling and enables flexible component swapping

properties.title: Design Patterns as Communication Tool
properties.context: Need common vocabulary for discussing design solutions
properties.decision: Use established design patterns for recurring problems
properties.rationale: Patterns provide proven solutions and facilitate team communication

properties.title: Encapsulation for State Protection
properties.context: Object state must be protected from inconsistent modifications
properties.decision: Hide internal state behind validated accessors
properties.rationale: Ensures object invariants and enables safe refactoring

properties.title: Polymorphism for Extensibility
properties.context: Systems need to support multiple implementations without code changes
properties.decision: Use polymorphism to program to interfaces, not implementations
properties.rationale: Enables extension without modification and flexible behavior

properties.title: Constructor Injection for Dependencies
properties.context: Objects need dependencies but should not create them
properties.decision: Inject dependencies through constructor to make dependencies explicit
properties.rationale: Makes dependencies clear and enables easy testing with mocks

properties.title: Separation of Concerns
properties.context: Business logic mixes with infrastructure concerns creating maintenance burden
properties.decision: Separate business logic, presentation, persistence, and cross-cutting concerns
properties.rationale: Enables independent evolution and easier testing

properties.title: Loose Coupling via Interfaces
properties.context: Components have direct dependencies causing ripple effects during changes
properties.decision: Use interface-based dependencies to decouple components
properties.rationale: Enables independent testing and flexible component replacement

nodes.label: ADR-011: High Cohesion Through Responsibility Grouping

properties.title: High Cohesion Through Responsibility Grouping
properties.context: Classes mix unrelated responsibilities making code harder to understand
properties.decision: Group related functionality together with minimal interaction across groups

properties.title: Testable Design Principles
properties.context: Code is difficult to test due to tight coupling and hidden dependencies
properties.decision: Design code with testability in mind from the start
properties.rationale: Enables comprehensive testing and confidence in code changes

nodes.label: TC-001: Class Definition - Valid Object Creation

testCase.given: A class User with properties name and email
testCase.when: Creating a User object with valid data
testCase.then: Object should be created with correct properties
Constructor should throw exception or return validation error
Access should be denied, only through accessors

testCase.given: Parent class with virtual method and child class overriding it
Parent and child classes with constructors
testCase.then: Parent constructor should be called first
Compilation error or runtime contract violation
Should delegate to composed object correctly

testCase.given: Parent class and multiple child implementations
testCase.then: Should work correctly with any child
Should be impossible or create new object
Correct object type should be created
Behavior should be correct despite depth
Should compare by identity, not value
Should cascade failures if not abstracted

testCase.given: Static and instance methods with same name

testCase.then: Changes should be visible through all references
Should be safely shared without synchronization
Should return true for value equality
Should return true only for same reference
Transient fields should not be serialized

properties.name: Developer
properties.title: Software Developer
properties.focusArea: Writing code that applies OOP principles effectively

properties.name: Architect
properties.title: Software Architect
properties.focusArea: Designing systems using OOP principles and patterns

properties.name: TechLead
properties.title: Technical Lead / Senior Developer
properties.focusArea: Guiding team on OOP best practices and code quality

properties.name: Factory Method
properties.purpose: Create objects without specifying exact classes
properties.problem: Direct instantiation couples code to concrete classes
properties.solution: Define interface for object creation in subclasses

properties.name: Singleton
properties.purpose: Ensure single instance and global access point
properties.problem: Need single instance of critical object
properties.solution: Hide constructor and provide static accessor

properties.name: Decorator
properties.problem: Inheritance causes class explosion for combinations

properties.name: Facade
properties.purpose: Provide simple interface to complex subsystem

properties.name: Proxy
properties.problem: Need access control or lazy initialization
properties.solution: Proxy provides same interface as real subject

properties.name: Strategy
properties.purpose: Define algorithm family and make interchangeable

properties.name: Observer
properties.purpose: Notify multiple objects about state changes
properties.problem: Tight coupling between state changes and handlers

properties.name: Command
properties.problem: Need to queue, log, or undo operations

properties.name: State
properties.purpose: Allow object behavior to change with state
properties.problem: Behavior depends on state with conditional logic

properties.name: Template Method
properties.purpose: Define algorithm skeleton in parent class
properties.problem: Algorithms have similar structure, different steps
properties.solution: Parent defines template, subclasses implement steps

properties.name: Visitor
properties.purpose: Separate algorithms from objects they work on

properties.name: Builder
properties.purpose: Construct complex objects step by step
properties.problem: Complex constructor with many optional parameters

properties.name: Chain of Responsibility
properties.purpose: Pass request along chain of handlers
properties.problem: Sender doesn't know which handler will process
